title: whisper-signal.v3
description: Contextual authored signal with reviewed material origin; origin grants no source independence or credibility.

signal/polarity.description: Fundamental polarity of the whisper signal. `problem` describes a distributed harm, failure, or dignity risk that may require correlation and protective response. `idea` describes a convergent idea, creative discovery, or emerging approach that may justify co-creation. Emergency handling MUST NOT be triggered solely by an `idea` signal.

epistemic/class.description: Explicit epistemic class that prevents the artifact from being treated as evidence.

signal/text.description: Sanitized text accepted by the local user before publication.

signal/text-native.description: Optional sanitized text in the original non-English language. Use this only when the original accepted user-facing wording is not English; English text stays solely in `signal/text`.

signal/text-native-lang.description: BCP 47-like language tag for `signal/text-native`. This field is intentionally non-English; English originals MUST omit both native-text fields and use only `signal/text`.

topic/class.description: Normalized issue class used for bounded correlation. Distinct from the enclosing envelope's `topic/key`, which is an Agora routing key; `topic/class` is the semantic correlation class carried inside the rumor body.

signal/similarity-key.description: Exact contextual correlation key. This required value is bound by the certificate profile/context; semantic similarity remains separate policy.

context/facets.description: Normalized, low-resolution facets that help correlation without forcing raw disclosure.

confidence.description: Local confidence in the quality and relevance of the prepared signal.

disclosure/scope.description: Maximum disclosure posture for the contextual signal. Public Agora ingress does not admit private-correlation; this value grants no dissemination authority.

source/class.description: Authorship and preparation posture of the signal; material origin is declared independently by origin/source-kinds. Existing Monus and Sensorium evidence requirements remain in force. This axis alone cannot supply or replace a material-origin declaration.

source/signal-kinds.description: Optional high-level local signal classes that materially informed a derived or sensorium-assisted rumor draft.

signal/grade.description: Signal salience grade. For `problem` signals this grades protective risk and urgency. For `idea` signals this grades convergence strength, co-creation potential, or urgency of matching interested participants. Routing and disclosure policy MAY interpret the same scale differently by `signal/polarity`.

routing/failure-mode.description: Whether the sender allows downgrade if the requested transport posture cannot be satisfied.

relay/acceptable-classes.description: Optional relay classes acceptable for outbound privacy realization.

forwarding/max-hops.description: Maximum number of relay hops allowed for the signal.

forwarding/budget.description: Maximum number of bounded forwards allowed under local policy.
